column1: # Observation edges: what a test observes WITHOUT a cargo dependency edge.
# walks every workspace member's `tests/**` and `src/**` and writes this table,
# row and on a STALE one. `tools/scripts/ci_selected_packages.py
# --observation-edges` unions the edges into the reverse cargo closure.
# Columns, tab separated: observing package, observed package, kind, and the
# source line that witnesses the edge. One row per edge; the witness is the
# first source line that carries it. `all` in the observed column means the walk
# could not attribute the read to one package, so the observing package is
# selected on every change and no step of it may be gated.
